messages:
alex: Quick follow-up from the compact-trace RFC — thinking about a handshake for batch compaction at ingress. TL;DR: propose a negotiable window (50-200ms) between write and compact to balance cost and reconstruction fidelity. thoughts?

maria: short — curious why 50ms lower bound? are we optimizing for high qps services?

alex: yes, mostly high qps tails. We're seeing KV caching + compacting reduces storage ~40% in presim. 50ms keeps per-request latency neutral when we do it async. numbers from bench attached.

raj: can we make window per-tenant? e.g., low-traffic tenants get 500ms, high-traffic 50ms?

sam: +1 per-tenant. but complexity spikes: routing, shard metadata, rollout. How do we surface to customers?

maria: concern: longer windows = worse end-to-end trace reconstructability for debugging. what about keeping full events for errors and compacting only success paths?

alex: good idea. we can tag spans as important via sampling rules. Proposal: compact by default; mark errors / sampled eval traces with `trace.keep=1` to skip compaction.

raj: operational question: how does this interact with billing attribution? compacted spans still need cost attribution metadata preserved.

alex: we keep cost keys in envelope root and attach minimal lineage. compaction just removes repeated dense payloads (payloads go into separate compact store), keys stay.

ingest-bot: [ingest-bot] compacted_batch accepted: batch_id=cb-20260315-9, tenant=acme, shards=8, window_ms=100

sam: rollout: start with internal tenants & canary on staging, measure query hit rate and reconstruction failure. I can own canary.

maria: +1. also add a migration toggle: keep both full+compacted for 24h to validate.

alex: thanks — I'll draft a short RFC addendum with config options: per-tenant window, error-exempt flag, compact-store TTL, migration double-write window. ping me if you want to be listed as reviewer.

raj: I'll volunteer to review perf sims.

sam: I'll add canary playbook and metrics to watch: compaction_rate, reconstruction_failure_pct, cost_delta.

maria: ok. one more: make sure trace query UI can indicate compacted traces and show "expand" opt.

alex: noted. will include UX hooks. thanks all :rocket:
